verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say integrations can 'trigger automations, eliminate manual work'. They also mention shipping 'reusable workflow blocks', running workflows 'the moment data changes', and automating status updates on a schedule. That indicates a first-party automation capability, but the evidence never describes a trigger-and-action rule builder, and some items are developer event subscriptions rather than user-built rules. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a trigger/condition/action rule builder, the catalog of available triggers and actions, rule configuration and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Enable 2-way sync between monday products and any platform you work with to trigger automations, eliminate manual work, and keep your business in motion.
Ship new reusable workflow blocks, agent skills, and board column types.
Listen for real-time events and run your workflow the moment data changes.
Automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule.
